decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location PlanBlock PlanAB-MEM001 R1AB-MEM002AB-MEM003AB-MEM004AB-MEM005 R1AB-MEM006AB-MEM007AB-MEM008AB-MEM009AB-MEM010Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

The "hobby room" indicated on drawing AB-MEM005 R1, shall not be occupied at any time other than for the purpose of accommodation ancillary to the occupation of the existing dwelling. Reason: To ensure that the development complies with adopted standards and is in character with the existing form of development in the locality.
